# Research Toolkit

> Research methods, workflow tools, and independent review for AI agents. 面向 AI Agent 的研究方法、执行工具与独立审阅。

Use the methods through repository access, files, attachments, or pasted instructions. Native Skill installation is optional. Plugin and local MCP integrations provide executable workflow tools; their dependencies and reviewer configuration are described in the usage guide.

## Research methods

- [Research instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/SKILL.md): The entry point, with links to methods for each research stage.
- [中文研究指令](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/SKILL.zh-CN.md): Chinese reading version.
- [Research guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/research-guide.md): Research scope, evidence, writing, and review.

## Usage

- [Project overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/README.md): Capabilities, a complete research request, and the case study.
- [中文项目介绍](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese overview and research request.
- [Agent setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/agents/README.md): Repository, file, attachment, and text input methods.
- [Tools and configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/usage-modes.md): Optional plugin and MCP setup, dependencies, and reviewer configuration.
- [工具与配置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/usage-modes.zh-CN.md): Chinese usage guide.

## Research case

- [Office agent research in China](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/case-study/report.en.md): English translation of a September 2026 report based on public sources, without installed-product testing.
- [国内办公 Agent 调研](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/case-study/report.zh-CN.md): Chinese report.
- [Case archive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/case-study/office-agents/README.md): Initial and final manuscripts, sources, and review decisions. The revisions are not a controlled test of toolkit effectiveness.

## Optional

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/README.md): Detailed methods and development documentation.
- [Evaluation status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrrrrredy/research-toolkit/main/docs/evaluation-status.md): Available evaluation evidence and its limits.
